sources.interpretation: The provider reference documents strict schema adherence for this field. Absence of strict from the guide example is not evidence that Responses lacks the field. Backend constrained-decoding enforcement cannot be established from this reference or the two failures.
This guide explicitly demonstrates strict mode through Chat Completions. It does not prove that migrating our full schema will eliminate every provider error.
Read together with the expanded API reference, not as a complete list of supported fields.
Provider-owned Chat request types include optional strict in JSONSchema. No new SDK dependency is needed for the proposed OpenAI-client adapter.
